chapman.name: Ear (otitis media)
chapman.anterior: Upper edge of the medial clavicle, just beyond where it crosses the 1st rib
chapman.posterior: C1 transverse process

chapman.name: Paranasal sinuses (sinusitis)
chapman.anterior: 1st intercostal space and upper edge of the 2nd rib
chapman.posterior: C2, between the spinous and transverse processes

chapman.name: Pharynx (pharyngitis)
chapman.anterior: 1st rib, about 3/4 inch from the sternum
chapman.posterior: C2 transverse process

chapman.name: Tonsils (tonsillitis)
chapman.anterior: 1st intercostal space, next to the sternum
chapman.posterior: C1 transverse process

chapman.name: Larynx (laryngitis)
chapman.anterior: Upper edge of the 2nd rib, about 3/4 inch from the sternum
chapman.posterior: C2, between the spinous and transverse processes

chapman.name: Heart
chapman.anterior: 2nd intercostal space, next to the sternum
chapman.posterior: Between the T2 and T3 transverse processes

chapman.name: Bronchi (bronchitis)
chapman.anterior: 2nd intercostal space, next to the sternum
chapman.posterior: T2 transverse process

chapman.name: Esophagus (GERD)
chapman.anterior: 2nd intercostal space, next to the sternum
chapman.posterior: T2, between the spinous and transverse processes

chapman.name: Upper lung (pneumonia, asthma)
chapman.anterior: 3rd intercostal space, next to the sternum
chapman.posterior: Between the T3 and T4 transverse processes

chapman.name: Lower lung (pneumonia, pleurisy)
chapman.anterior: 4th intercostal space, next to the sternum
chapman.posterior: Between the T4 and T5 transverse processes

chapman.name: Liver
chapman.anterior: Right 5th and 6th intercostal spaces
chapman.posterior: Right, between the T5-T6 and T6-T7 transverse processes

chapman.name: Gallbladder (cholecystitis)
chapman.anterior: Right 6th intercostal space
chapman.posterior: Right, between the T6 and T7 transverse processes

chapman.name: Stomach - acidity (gastric ulcer)
chapman.anterior: Left 5th intercostal space
chapman.posterior: Left, between the T5 and T6 transverse processes

chapman.name: Stomach - peristalsis
chapman.anterior: Left 6th intercostal space
chapman.posterior: Left, between the T6 and T7 transverse processes

chapman.name: Pancreas (diabetes)
chapman.anterior: Right 7th intercostal space
chapman.posterior: Right, between the T7 and T8 transverse processes

chapman.name: Spleen (infection)
chapman.anterior: Left 7th intercostal space
chapman.posterior: Left, between the T7 and T8 transverse processes

chapman.name: Small intestine (enteritis, Crohn disease)
chapman.anterior: 8th, 9th and 10th intercostal spaces, both sides
chapman.posterior: Between the T8-T9, T9-T10 and T10-T11 transverse processes

chapman.name: Appendix (appendicitis)
chapman.anterior: Tip of the right 12th rib
chapman.posterior: Right T11 transverse process

chapman.name: Cecum / ileocecal valve
chapman.anterior: Right lateral thigh, upper fifth at the greater trochanter
chapman.posterior: Triangle from the L2-L4 transverse processes down to the iliac crest

chapman.name: Ascending colon
chapman.anterior: Right lateral thigh, middle portion
chapman.posterior: Triangle from the L2-L4 transverse processes down to the iliac crest

chapman.name: Hepatic flexure (first 2/5 of the transverse colon)
chapman.anterior: Right lateral thigh, lowest fifth just above the knee
chapman.posterior: Triangle from the L2-L4 transverse processes down to the iliac crest

chapman.name: Splenic flexure (last 3/5 of the transverse colon)
chapman.anterior: Left lateral thigh, lowest fifth just above the knee
chapman.posterior: Triangle from the L2-L4 transverse processes down to the iliac crest

chapman.name: Descending colon
chapman.anterior: Left lateral thigh, middle portion
chapman.posterior: Triangle from the L2-L4 transverse processes down to the iliac crest

chapman.name: Sigmoid colon
chapman.anterior: Left lateral thigh, upper fifth at the greater trochanter
chapman.posterior: Triangle from the L2-L4 transverse processes down to the iliac crest

chapman.name: Kidney
chapman.anterior: 1 inch above and 1 inch lateral to the umbilicus
chapman.posterior: Between the T12 and L1 transverse processes

chapman.name: Urinary bladder (cystitis)
chapman.anterior: Around the umbilicus and at the pubic symphysis
chapman.posterior: Upper edge of the L2 transverse process

chapman.name: Urethra
chapman.anterior: Inner edge of the pubic ramus near the top of the symphysis
chapman.posterior: Upper edge of the L2 transverse process

chapman.name: Ovary (ovarian cyst)
chapman.anterior: Superior-medial pubic tubercle, along the upper border of the pubic bone
chapman.posterior: T9-T10 (inner half) and T10-T11 (outer half), between the transverse processes

chapman.name: Uterus
chapman.anterior: Upper edge of the junction of the pubic ramus with the ischium, at the obturator foramen
chapman.posterior: Between the L5 spinous process and the PSIS

chapman.name: Prostate (prostatitis)
chapman.anterior: Lateral thigh from the greater trochanter to 2 inches above the knee
chapman.posterior: Between the L5 spinous process and the PSIS

chapman.name: Broad ligament (uterine position)
chapman.anterior: Lateral thigh from the greater trochanter to 2 inches above the knee
chapman.posterior: Between the L5 spinous process and the PSIS

chapman.name: Thyroid (thyroiditis, hyper/hypo)
chapman.anterior: 2nd intercostal space, next to the sternum
chapman.posterior: T2 transverse process

chapman.name: Adrenal gland (fatigue, hypertension)
chapman.anterior: 2 inches above and 1 inch lateral to the umbilicus
chapman.posterior: Between the T11 and T12 transverse processes

chapman.name: Upper limb neuritis
chapman.anterior: 3rd intercostal space, next to the sternum
chapman.posterior: Between the T3 and T4 transverse processes

chapman.name: Hand or shoulder: Dupuytren contracture, frozen shoulder (Parker's reflex)
chapman.anterior: Upper anterior edge of the scapula just below the head of the humerus

chapman.name: Arm circulation (numbness, tingling)
chapman.anterior: Pectoralis minor at its attachments to ribs 3-5
chapman.posterior: Superior angle and inner margin of the scapula, over ribs 1-3

chapman.name: Sciatic neuritis (lumbosacral radiculopathy)
chapman.anterior: Posterolateral thigh, starting 2-3 inches below the greater trochanter
chapman.posterior: Upper part of the sacroiliac joint
